cli.scope: CLI ICC envelope and AAC-LC/PCE/wave; two-track real owned MOV converted to stz2. ffprobe demux DTS/PTS include its edit handling; raw stts/ctts preservation is also checked by Rust tests. No colour/audio rendering or device acceptance.
cli.ffprobe_version: ffprobe version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2007-2026 the FFmpeg developers

timed_metadata.scope: Google Mp4BoxReader primitive actually used by MetadataEngine, not all facade/device behavior
differences: Pinned Google selects by stts, omits ctts/edit mapping and clamps after the last sample.
Rust honors composition and exact unit-rate edits, returns no sample outside half-open intervals, and preserves raw packet bytes.

limits: Google builder primary-track path deletes metadata; Rust optimizer retains it. Removal requires explicit track selection.
Google MP4CopyTrack is audited as an internal primitive; this does not claim Google exposes arbitrary track import through its facade.
Fragmented/indexed/external/unknown reference layouts are rejected by the bounded Rust API.
No metadata track or Moments construction is performed.
